composites.name: fig1_architecture
composites.description: Fig 1 — the integrated M. genitalium cell: FBA metabolism + mass + stochastic expression wired through shared cell-variable stores.

composites.name: fig2_growth
composites.description: Fig 2 — cell growth: mass accumulation, doubling time (~9 h), and dry-mass composition from FBA-driven growth.

composites.name: fig3_expression
composites.description: Fig 3 — gene expression dynamics: stochastic transcription/translation/decay producing bursty mRNA and accumulating protein across the representative gene panel.

seed.description: Random seed for the stochastic expression

composites.name: fig5_energy
composites.description: Fig 5 — global energy allocation: ATP/GTP production from FBA alongside the GTP/NTP consumption of transcription and translation.

composites.name: fig4_cell_cycle
composites.description: Fig 4 — emergent cell-cycle regulation: dNTP-buffered three-phase replication (initiation → replication → done) where initiation-phase dNTP surplus controls replication speed.

initial_dnaA.description: DnaA monomers present at cell birth (shortens initiation)

initial_dntp.description: dNTP molecules present at cell birth

composites.name: fig6_gene_essentiality
composites.description: Fig 6 — single-gene-disruption phenotypes: knock out a metabolic gene and measure growth via FBA (essential if growth collapses).

disrupted_gene.description: Gene id to knock out (e.g. MG_023); empty = wild-type

composites.name: fig7_kinetic_parameters
composites.description: Fig 7 — kinetic-parameter characterization: scale a target reaction's flux bound (a kcat proxy) and measure the effect on growth.

reaction_id.description: Reaction whose flux bound (kcat proxy) to scale

bound_scale.description: Multiplier on the reaction's flux bound
